thresholds.nearestLists: one maximum-similarity legacy/sealed match per generated row and metric

policy.candidateEvidenceReuse: Counted and requires explanation. Reuse alone does not fail when both trigger primitive and exception-chain signatures differ; reuse combined with either matching trigger or matching exception chain fails closed.
policy.manualReview: Semantic descriptor near matches are not auto-cleared; every listed item requires a human decision before Gate C acceptance.
